ai_artifact_stamp_ck.name: ai_artifact_stamp_ck
ai_artifact_stamp_ck.value: stamp = '[DRAFT – AI-GENERATED ASSISTANCE – REQUIRES AO VERIFICATION]'

disposition_reassigned_redirect_ck.name: disposition_reassigned_redirect_ck
disposition_reassigned_redirect_ck.value: "disposition"."type" <> 'reassigned' or "disposition"."redirect_to_user_id" is not null or "disposition"."redirect_to_entry_id" is not null

disposition_gate_ck.name: disposition_gate_ck
disposition_gate_ck.value: "disposition"."type" not in ('concurred','nonconcurred') or ("disposition"."gate_id" is not null and "disposition"."gate_round" is not null)

document_version_body_ck.name: document_version_body_ck
document_version_body_ck.value: "document_version"."body_md" is not null or "document_version"."blob_key" is not null

document_version_author_ck.name: document_version_author_ck
document_version_author_ck.value: ("document_version"."author_type" = 'human' and "document_version"."author_user_id" is not null) or ("document_version"."author_type" = 'ai' and "document_version"."ai_artifact_id" is not null)

escalation_resolution_ck.name: escalation_resolution_ck
escalation_resolution_ck.value: "escalation"."resolved_at" is null or (coalesce(length(trim("escalation"."resolution")),0) > 0 and ("escalation"."resolved_by" is not null or "escalation"."auto_closed"))

escalation_auto_closed_ck.name: escalation_auto_closed_ck
escalation_auto_closed_ck.value: not "escalation"."auto_closed" or ("escalation"."resolved_at" is not null and "escalation"."resolved_by" is null)

registry_entry_alternate_ck.name: registry_entry_alternate_ck
registry_entry_alternate_ck.value: "registry_entry"."designated_alternate_position_id" is not null or "registry_entry"."designated_alternate_user_id" is not null

registry_entry_active_validated_ck.name: registry_entry_active_validated_ck
registry_entry_active_validated_ck.value: "registry_entry"."status" <> 'active' or ("registry_entry"."last_validated_at" is not null and "registry_entry"."validated_by" is not null)

tasker_released_fields_ck.name: tasker_released_fields_ck
tasker_released_fields_ck.value: "tasker"."released_at" is null or ("tasker"."tasking_authority_id" is not null and "tasker"."current_suspense_plan_id" is not null and "tasker"."transmit_to_higher_hq" is not null and "tasker"."submitted_for_release_at" is not null)

tasker_closed_fields_ck.name: tasker_closed_fields_ck
tasker_closed_fields_ck.value: ("tasker"."state" = 'CLOSED') = ("tasker"."closed_disposition_type" is not null and "tasker"."final_disposition_id" is not null and "tasker"."closed_at" is not null)

tasker_elevated_nonconcurrence_ck.name: tasker_elevated_nonconcurrence_ck
tasker_elevated_nonconcurrence_ck.value:
"tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence" is null or (
        jsonb_typeof("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->'gate_ids') = 'array'
        and jsonb_typeof("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->'gate_rounds') = 'array'
        and jsonb_array_length("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->'gate_ids') > 0
        and jsonb_array_length("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->'gate_ids') = jsonb_array_length("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->'gate_rounds')
        and coalesce(length(trim("tasker"."elevated_nonconcurrence"->>'rationale')), 0) > 0
      )
